newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand postpones CPI announcement to Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Thailand postpones CPI announcement to Tuesday.

text.p: Thailand's commerce ministry has postponed the announcement of the consumer price index for the first eleven months of 1996 until Tuesday due to a change in government, a senior official said.

"The ministry decided to postpone the annoucement of consumer price index to tomorrow. We want the new minister to make the announcement by himself," commerce ministry permanent secretary Sompol Kiatphaibool told Reuters on Monday.
Sompol said the announcement, originally due to be made on Monday, was expected by noon on Tuesday.
Narongchai Akrasanee, former chairman of General Finance and Securities Plc, on Sunday was sworn in as the new commerce minister in Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh's government.
Thailand's consumer price index, which measures inflation, rose 4.3 percent year-on-year in October -- its slowest rate in three year.
